description:
Fit the NA50 continuum with shared nuisance parameters.

The 400 GeV publication supplies the shared luminosity and asymmetric
extraction errors. For 450 GeV, the unpublished decomposition is bracketed
by common-systematic correlation fractions rho=0, 0.5, 1; it is not claimed
to be a measured covariance. PDF/scale hypotheses are fitted independently,
without assigning posterior probabilities to PDF families.
parameters: Common proton-initiated DY normalization at tungsten, and A exponent; no light-meson or bremsstrahlung parameters refitted.
extrapolation: Normalization is continued to other dimuon masses and secondary proton energies; PDF/scale shape variations are retained. Pion and other non-proton initiated production is not normalized by proton data.
covariance: 400: published target-specific errors, shared 3% luminosity and shared asymmetric extraction. 450: target statistics plus the bracketed common/independent systematic decomposition. Between energies, normalization nuisance parameters are independent.
confidence: Delta chi2=1 profile intervals for the normalization, enveloped over the unresolved 450 GeV correlation and separate theory hypotheses.

predictions.method: Differential fixed-order NLO QCD, photon-mediated dimuons, nf=3 incoming quarks, massless muons, muF=muR=M centrally. Exact measured rapidity, mass and Collins–Soper cuts applied to Born, real and subtraction events.
predictions.generator: MadGraph5_aMC@NLO 3.6.4; process p p > mu+ mu- / z [QCD]
predictions.isospin: 400 GeV published pp-equivalent cross sections; 450 GeV target mixture from independent pp and isospin-swapped pn integrations.
predictions.unsupported_scales: NNPDF half-scale 400 GeV integrals replace M<3.3 GeV with CT18 at central scales, matching the source weights.
